test_title: PYST 16: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'TURNIP' is coded as VNRUWU and 'DAIKON' is coded as TTOLCE. How will 'RADISH' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'TURNIP' is coded as VNRUWU.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51f5298e93b8c7213b846a954695ed7754a0adc78b44272f3903707daf22ffd1.png] 

and

'DAIKON' is coded as TTOLCE.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff5eecc8357c844bbc4c1d3ecf599eb118ec1ed2f4907d4fb4f11179e5d748ba.png] 

Similarly,

'RADISH' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/448c4ae0c3393bdf9cd73ec9f64f2c30b2ebc4902204deab336348a67cfce920.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"NXMGCS".**
